findings.issue: Incorrect login command referenced in first-time user notification message
findings.evidence: Message says 'Vui lòng dùng /lich-hoc để đăng nhập' but /lich-hoc is the schedule viewing command (line 6-7 in schedule.js). The actual login command is /lich-hoc-login (defined in login.js lines 14-16).
findings.consequence: Users without stored credentials receive incorrect instructions, preventing them from successfully logging in to receive schedule notifications.
findings.fix: Change line 122 to: await member.send('Bạn chưa đăng nhập hệ thống lịch. Vui lòng dùng /lich-hoc-login để đăng nhập.');
